description: This script orchestrates stress testing of OpenSSL components by executing various test functions, capturing system metrics, and logging results. It includes functions for different cryptographic tests, system resource monitoring, and sequential execution of tests with timing and resource usage measurement.

methods.description: Executes a command multiple times in parallel, redirecting output to /dev/null.

methods.description: Logs messages with timestamp and script basename to the log file.
